Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses PREQUALIFICATION CRITERIA The bidders shall upload following pre-qualification documents along with their offer as per mentioned in PART-I of e-tender: Pre-qualification Criteria: 1) Past work experience: Bidders should have successfully executed/completed job for carrying out s imilar type of jobs like repair of chain pulley block/monorail/EOT Crane repa ir/maintenance and load testing, in Chemical/Fertilizer/Petro-chemical/Steel Industry/Power/Cement/Port. Against the claim, the submitted work order c opies should be issued and executed during the last seven years ending th e last day of month previous to the one in which this subject tender is float ed/issued. Note: 1. Only completed work orders shall be considered. 2. Submitted PO/WO shall be issued and submitted during last seven ye ars ending last day of month previous to one in which applications/bids are invited. 3. Subcontracting work (work order executed under subcontract) shall n ot be considered for prequalification. Proof of execution of submitted work order, bidder have to submit any of the following – (i) Completion Certificate / Customer Acceptance Certificate OR performance / job completion ce rtificate from end user

(ii) GeM SDAC (Service Delivery and Acceptance Certificate) document OR (iii) (a) The certified job execution work sheet along with Tax Invoice to the extent of the required Pre-Qualification value and (b) Proof of receipt of payment like bank statement for the above referred tax invoice. 2) Ownership of company with name, addresses and telephone nos. of proprieto rs/ partners/directors. 3) Copy of Partnership deed /proprietorship/ Memorandum and article of associa tion and certificate of incorporation as the case may be. 4) Shall submit Provident Fund Registration details, ESIC regis tration details, PAN details and GST details etc. ATC/Packet:1: Scanned copy of i) No Deviation undertaking i.e. Annexure IIIA ii) Annexure-VI i.e. GST clauses iii) Annexure-XIIA i.e. as per 144(xi) of GFR-2017 iv) UDYAM certificate. vi) Annexure XVIA and XVIB i.e. . Declaration of Status of Debarment Listi ng/ Blacklisting/ Holiday Listing and Undertaking about common Directors/ Part ners/ Interest in other associated units/ companies. ATC/Packet:2: Scanned copy of “Work-order copies as per requirement mentioned in Pre-qu alification criteria" ATC/Packet:3: Scanned copy of “Completion Certificate or documents indicating work compl , etion as per requirement mentioned in Pre-qualification criteria" ATC/Packet:4:Scanned copy of “Details of the Company/Ownership with name, address, pho ne nos of Proprietors/Partners/Directors”. ATC/Packet:5:Scanned copy of “copy of Partnership deed/proprietorship/Memorandum and a rticle of association etc.”. ATC/Packet:6:Scanned copy of “Duly filled, signed and stamped copy of the technical bid/ch Annexure-III eck list i.e. ” and any other documents, if requested in sco pe of work, mentioned in tender document. ATC/Packet:7:Scanned copy of “Vendor Update form i.e. Annexure-X, along with all the supp orting documents”. Methodology for award of contract in the ratio of 55:45, shall be as follows: 1) If L1 bidder is a MSE bidder then, 55% of Work Order value shall be offered

to L-1 bidder and remaining 45% Work Order value shall be offered to L-2 party subject to acceptance/matching of L-1 rates. If L2 bidder do not acce pt/match the L1 rates, the L-1 rates shall be offered to L3, L4, …. & so on b idders. If no other bidder accepts L1 rates, then contract for 100 % value s hall be lined up with L1 bidder. 2) In case L1 bidder is not a MSE bidder, then L1 bidder shall be awarded 55% of the WO value and L1 rates shall be offered to the nearest MSE bidder w ho is within L1+15% price band. After matching of the rates by this MSE bi dder balance 45% of the WO value shall be awarded to him. 3) In case there is no MSE bidder within price band of L1+15% OR if such MS E bidder does not agree to match the rates of L1 bidder, the rates shall be offered to L2, L3……. bidders for further acceptance. 4) In case there are more than one MSE Bidder within the L1+15% price band , further division amongst them shall not be done due to contract operabili ty issues in the field. 5) If no other bidder accepts L1 rates, then contract for 100 % value shall be l ined up with L1 bidder .
